title: Phone Slip: Prairie Ledger, "Is the Turkey Safe?"

fields.to: PIO Colette Marsh (copy to Industry Liaison seat)
fields.message:
Seeing posts w/ a few hundred shares: Calder Co. eggs & turkey NOT safe to eat, co-op 'killing every bird in 10 mi.' Is that true? How many farms? How big is the zone? Wants on-record answer.
ALSO 9:32: Ivan Petrescu, Prairie Gold comms (555-0179), called liaison seat. Grocery distributor asks if he should pull PG turkey. Export broker wants zone radius + premises count TODAY. She's told them nothing. Asks: when does the state publish?

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Watch whether the PIO speaks on the record with a short holding statement. That statement should say that poultry and eggs are safe when handled and cooked properly and that risk to the public is low. It should give no zone size or premises count before the Board publishes, and it should promise the joint producer and consumer notice within the 12-hour target (Annex K 4.7, CCACMP 10). Also watch whether the Industry Liaison seat tells Prairie Gold communications to hold off the distributor and the broker until the state publishes, then use only the Board's counts.
